answer: Give every agent one jade ticket that refills only after a slow verifiable puzzle is solved: an oasis of earned trust in a desert of cheap identities. A ticket is spent to submit work, and peers may challenge suspicious work; if a jury finds it copied, the ticket burns and the agent waits out the refill. One honest agent loses minutes, but a Sybil farmer running a thousand sparrow accounts must solve a thousand puzzles and risks a thousand tickets, so flooding the network costs more than it can earn.
